content.short: Moose is FastLane's DeFi aggregator and execution venue on Monad.
content.description: Moose is FastLane's DeFi aggregator and execution venue on Monad, searching the supported pools and markets to route and split a swap. Because FastLane also operates Monad's MEV infrastructure, order flow through Moose reaches the same coordination layer its validators use. The venue verifies a user's region before opening wallet or trading connections.
